instruction: Use terminal commands to launch GIMP, open "cola.png", flip it horizontally, and save the mirrored image as "flipped.png" for the reflection effect.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "alt", "t"); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires flipping the cola.png image horizontally (mirror). The evaluator checks if the output image is a horizontal mirror of the original by comparing it with the original flipped using PIL's FLIP_LEFT_RIGHT transformation. Uses SSIM with 0.99 threshold for comparison.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies horizontal mirroring by comparing result image with PIL-flipped reference
Getter properly retrieves the output file (flipped.png) from VM and caches it locally
Metric uses appropriate SSIM comparison with 0.99 threshold to account for minor compression artifacts
Expected value (original_path) correctly points to the source image /home/user/Desktop/cola.png
Metric correctly handles expected parameter - when expected.type='rule', it receives the rules dict directly
Complete coverage of instruction requirement: verifies the image was flipped horizontally
Proper error handling for None values and exceptions returns 0.0 on failure
